product_overview: AhmedETAP is an AI-powered electrical power system engineering and simulation platform for utilities, industrial plants, and consultants. It combines secure multi-tenant access, standards-compliant electrical studies, and a chat-first engineering workspace with real-time visualization and knowledge retrieval.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication with tenant isolation and role-based access control
Enable standards-compliant power system studies including load flow, short circuit, arc flash, and protection coordination
Support a chat-first engineering workflow with streaming responses and specialist agents
Deliver interactive single-line diagram inspection and authoritative execution with fail-closed validation
Offer semantic and graph-based knowledge retrieval for engineering documents, standards, and topology context
Support SCADA and digital twin use cases with real-time telemetry and WebSocket updates

features.name: Authentication and Tenant Security
features.description: Protect platform access with JWT authentication, tenant isolation, and role-based controls for engineering workflows.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/token with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT access token -> Use token on POST /api/v1/studies/run -> Receive 200 with study job accepted or results payload
POST /api/v1/auth/token with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Retry authentication with corrected credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT access token
POST /api/v1/auth/token with valid credentials but insufficient tenant permissions -> Receive 403 forbidden when calling POST /api/v1/studies/run -> Access is denied due to tenant isolation

features.name: Power System Simulation Engines
features.description: Run standards-compliant electrical studies for load flow, short circuit, arc flash, protection coordination, motor starting, and harmonic analysis.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/studies/run with a valid load flow study payload -> Receive 200 with study result ID -> GET /api/v1/results/{id} -> Receive bus voltages, angles, flows, and losses
POST /api/v1/studies/run with a valid short circuit study payload -> Receive 200 with study result ID -> GET /api/v1/results/{id} -> Receive fault current results for configured fault types
POST /api/v1/studies/run with an invalid or incomplete study payload -> Receive 422 validation error -> Correct the study parameters -> POST /api/v1/studies/run -> Receive 200 with a valid result ID
GET /api/v1/results/{id} with an unknown or expired result ID -> Receive 404 not found -> Re-submit or query a valid result ID -> Receive 200 with computation results

features.name: Real-Time Chat-First Engineering Workspace
features.description: Provide a streaming conversational workspace for engineers to ask questions, execute studies, and interact with specialized agents and the engineering context.
user_flows: POST /api/chat/stream with a valid engineering question -> Receive streaming assistant responses -> Continue the conversation with follow-up prompts -> Receive contextual engineering guidance

POST /api/chat/stream with a request to run a study -> Receive streamed clarification and execution guidance -> POST /api/v1/studies/run with the validated parameters -> Receive 200 with computation result ID

POST /api/chat/stream with an unsupported or ambiguous request -> Receive streamed request for missing inputs -> Provide required parameters in a follow-up message -> Receive a constrained, non-hallucinated response
POST /api/chat/stream with a malformed payload -> Receive 422 validation error -> Resubmit with valid message structure -> Receive streamed response

features.name: Knowledge Retrieval and GraphRAG
features.description: Search engineering knowledge bases using semantic retrieval and relationship-aware graph queries for standards, documents, and topology context.
user_flows: POST /api/chat/stream with a standards lookup request -> Receive streamed answer grounded in retrieved knowledge -> Use the result to validate a study assumption -> Receive context-aware engineering guidance

POST /api/chat/stream with a topology or relationship query -> Receive a response informed by graph relationships -> Ask a follow-up about connected equipment -> Receive a refined explanation of the network context

POST /api/chat/stream with a query that has no relevant indexed knowledge -> Receive a grounded fallback indicating missing evidence -> Provide more specific terms or documents -> Receive a better-targeted retrieval response

POST /api/chat/stream with a request referencing unsupported or inaccessible content -> Receive a fail-closed response refusing to guess -> Supply approved documents or standard references -> Receive evidence-based output

features.name: Digital Twin and SCADA
features.description: Monitor and inspect real-time telemetry and digital twin state through IEC 61850-aligned data models and live updates.
user_flows: GET /health to verify backend availability -> Receive 200 with healthy status -> Open the SCADA/digital twin monitoring view -> Receive live telemetry updates through the platform's real-time channel

POST /api/chat/stream with a telemetry interpretation request -> Receive streamed analysis of current device states -> Use the interpretation to investigate an alarm or event -> Receive operational guidance
GET /health when a dependency is unavailable -> Receive degraded or unhealthy status -> Retry after recovery -> Receive healthy status and resume telemetry monitoring

POST /api/chat/stream with a request for unavailable telemetry data -> Receive a constrained response explaining missing data -> Provide the correct asset or time range -> Receive a valid contextual answer
